title: festuca procumbens
intro: Festuca procumbens, commonly known as creeping fescue or dwarf fescue, is a low-growing, perennial grass native to North America. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Festuca procumbens are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant are primarily lignans, which have been identified as the primary compounds responsible for its medicinal properties, although more research is needed to confirm its full range of bioactive compounds and effects.
